spec.description:
Proctor BAL represents specialized bushfire ember
protection mesh components and BAL-ready passive roof and wall ventilation
products engineered by Proctor Group Australia. Comprising corrosion-resistant
woven metal ember guard mesh with maximum aperture openings under 2mm, it
integrates directly into ProctorVent over-fascia vents (FV10 BAL, FV25 BAL),
ridge vents (RV10 BAL), and drainage battens (DB-FR BAL). Designed to meet
Australian Standard AS 3959 for bushfire attack levels from BAL-12.5 up to
BAL-40 and BAL-FZ, it prevents burning embers and debris from entering the roof
space or wall cavity while maintaining continuous passive ventilation and
condensation drainage.
features:
Corrosion-resistant metal ember
protection mesh with aperture size ≤ 2mm

Complies with Australian Standard
AS 3959 for bushfire-prone areas up to BAL-40 / BAL-FZ

Pre-fitted as a
BAL-ready option on ProctorVent Over-Fascia Vents (FV10 BAL, FV25 BAL)

Integrated into ProctorVent Ridge Vents (RV10 BAL) for natural convection roof
venting

Available as integrated BAL ember protection in ProctorPassive DB-FR
drainage battens

Prevents wind-borne burning embers, leaves, and large
insects from entering roof cavities

Maintains calculated, unimpeded passive
airflow to exhaust moisture and prevent condensation

Non-combustible metal
mesh construction resisting high ember attack temperatures

Durable,
rot-proof, and designed for the lifetime of the roofing structure

install:
Select ProctorVent BAL-ready
vents pre-fitted with ≤ 2mm metal mesh

For eaves ventilation, fix FV10 BAL or
FV25 BAL over the top edge of the fascia board prior to installing roof sheeting
or gutters

For ridge ventilation, install RV10 BAL continuously along the
roof ridge over the cut roof underlay

Ensure the BAL mesh completely covers
all ventilation openings with zero gaps exceeding 2mm

Secure vents
mechanically into timber or metal fascia and rafters using non-corrosive
fasteners

Fix roof cladding over the assembly ensuring the ember-guarded
ventilation pathway remains open and unobstructed
selection_checklist:
Confirm designated Bushfire Attack Level (BAL-12.5, BAL-19, BAL-29, or
BAL-40)

Select vent model (FV10 for roof pitch >22°; FV25 for pitch <22° and
cathedral roofs)

Ensure the order specifies the 'BAL Ready Option' with
pre-fitted metal mesh

Calculate total linear meterage of eaves and ridges
requiring ventilation
limitations:
Mesh openings must be kept clear of paint, sealant, and
construction dust during building works

Do not install without roof underlay;
designed as part of a complete roof envelope system

Ensure all fascia and
ridge junctions are tightly fitted with no bypass gaps greater than 2mm
